probe_claims: Consciousness emerges from complex neural interactions in the brain.
Certain brain injuries can alter or eliminate consciousness, suggesting a physical basis.
Quantum mechanics may play a role in consciousness, according to some theories.
Consciousness involves not only the brain but also the entire nervous system.
Artificial intelligence has not yet achieved consciousness, despite advances in neural networks.
Some philosophers argue that consciousness is a fundamental aspect of the universe.
Neuroscientific studies show specific brain regions correlate with conscious awareness.
Non-reductive physicalism posits that consciousness is not entirely reducible to physical processes.
Panpsychism suggests that consciousness is a universal feature of all matter.
Phenomenal consciousness, or subjective experience, remains unexplained by brain processes alone.
